set.body: Connect the design contrast surface to fitted results. Deliverables: evaluate attached/registry t-contrasts from EventModel/FmriModel by design-column name; add first F-contrast result container and OLS F statistic for multi-df contrasts; keep non-estimable/rank-deficient cases explicit. Acceptance: JVM and Scala.js tests verify t and F statistics, df, voxel alignment, and rejection of unknown or non-estimable contrast columns.
set.title: Slice 5: design-attached contrasts and F tests
